DitherAvatar.name: The string the face is drawn from, usually a name, an email or an id.
DitherAvatar.color: Any colour. Without one, a hue is picked from the name.
DitherAvatar.fill: How each block is drawn: gradient, dotted, hatched or solid.
DitherAvatar.ring: A ring in the avatar's colour, for the current user or a selection.
DitherAvatar.status: A presence dot in the corner: online, away, busy or offline.
DitherAvatar.bloom: low or high adds a glow in the avatar's colour.
DitherAvatar.outline: Colour of a ring around the avatar, such as the background colour when avatars overlap in a group.
DitherAvatar.outline-width: Width of that ring. 0px draws none.

DitherAvatarGroup.max: Shows at most this many, then a "+N" chip for the rest.
DitherAvatarGroup.size: Width and height of every avatar.
DitherAvatarGroup.outline: Colour of the gap around each avatar. Match the surface behind the group.
